title: Animo Persona/Kind Definition (v0.1.5)
description: JSON Schema for animo.json. Validates STRUCTURE (types, required fields, snake_case keys, enums) at the ajv gate; SEMANTIC range constraints (numeric bounds) are intentionally delegated to the C# Validator (A005-A012, A034, etc.) so authoring errors produce human-readable diagnostics instead of cryptic ajv messages. (v0.1.5, Q-S108 first applied to reset_threshold; Q-S121 generalized to all range constraints.)

schema_version.description: Schema version. Backward-compat: 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5 all accepted; older versions rejected (A024).

snake_case_id.description: snake_case identifier (lowercase, digits, underscore separators). Must start with a letter. Pattern enforces this gate; A001/A002/A003 in C# Validator give human-readable diagnostics for which field carries the offending value.

need_value.description: (v0.1.5, Q-S121) Need value. Spec range [0.0, 100.0] (A005) is enforced by the C# Validator at parse time, not here. Schema-level minimum/maximum would silently dead-code A005 (cryptic ajv reject before the human-readable Error reaches the LLM author). See Q-S108 for the original observation; Q-S121 generalizes the principle.

rate_value.description: Need change rate per second. No hard min/max in spec (negative = grows toward 0; positive = grows toward 100). LLM cheat sheet (§19.3) suggests typical values 0.1 – 10.0.

coefficient.description: (v0.1.5, Q-S121) Influence coefficient. Spec range [-1.0, 1.0] (A012) is enforced by the C# Validator. See `need_value` description for rationale.

suppression_factor.description: (v0.1.5, Q-S121) Tier suppression factor. Spec range [0.0, 1.0] (A006) is enforced by the C# Validator. See `need_value` description for rationale.

tier.description: (v0.1.5, Q-S121) Maslow tier. Spec range [1, 5] (A007) is enforced by the C# Validator. 1 = physiological, 2 = safety, 3 = social, 4 = esteem, 5 = self-actualization. See `need_value` description for rationale.

exponent.description: (v0.1.5, Q-S121) Action urgency exponent. Spec range [0.1, 5.0] (A008) is enforced by the C# Validator. See `need_value` description for rationale.

needs_map.description: Need values per Need key. Keys must be snake_case identifiers (free Need names allowed; the 8 standard names — hunger, fatigue, fear, loneliness, confidence, curiosity, idle, frustration — are cataloged in Animo.Const). Values are numbers; range enforcement (A005, [0.0, 100.0]) lives in the C# Validator (Q-S121). additionalProperties:false ensures non-string keys are rejected, but patternProperties enforces snake_case on every key.

needs_meta_map.description: (v0.1.5, Q-S30 + Q-S89) Optional per-Need metadata for genre-custom Needs. Keys are snake_case Need identifiers (matching needs_map keys); values are NeedMeta objects carrying tier (∈ [1, 5], A038) and reserved fields for v0.2/v0.3 extensions. Pre-Q-S89 the Q-S30 needs_meta feature was schema-blocked because kind/persona had additionalProperties:false and no needs_meta property declaration — LLMs writing perfectly spec-compliant needs_meta would be rejected by ajv before reaching the C# Validator.

need_meta.description: (v0.1.5, Q-S30 + Q-S121) Per-Need metadata. Currently only tier (1-5 per Maslow, range enforced by C# Validator A038) — for genre-custom Needs that should participate in tier suppression (e.g. oxygen=tier1 in survival games). v0.2/v0.3 may add decay_multiplier, label, etc.

tier.description: Maslow tier (1-5) for Need participation in §9.3.4 max_lower_tier_intensity. Validator A038 enforces the [1, 5] range with a human-readable Error (Q-S121).

rates_map.description: Rate values per Need key. Keys must be snake_case identifiers. Values are unbounded numbers (typical range per §19.3).

suppression.description: Tier-level suppression factors. Only tier2..tier5 are allowed (A006). All omitted means no dynamic suppression at the corresponding tier.

influence.description: A directed need-to-need effect (A012, A025). Cycles are detected by the runtime Validator (A025).

action.description: An action definition. As of v0.1.1, 'need' is required (A022) and 'base_score' is removed.

id.description: Action identifier. Free-form non-empty string (A009). PascalCase recommended (e.g. Flee, SearchFood).

commitment.description: (v0.1.5, Q-S121) Action continuation bonus (v0.1.3+). The 'decay' field was removed in v0.1.3. The whole object may be omitted; default bonus is 0.0. Bonus range [0, 50] (Q8) and Warning above 30 (A028) are enforced by the C# Validator, not by schema minimum/maximum (Q-S121 generalization of Q-S108).

bonus.description: Score bonus added to the currently chosen action every frame. Does not decay over time. Recommended 5-20. Range [0, 50] enforced by A028 (v0.1.5: Q8 + Q-S121); above 30 → Warning, negative → Error.

threshold.description: Two-stage threshold trigger for Germio Bus publishing (v0.1.1). 'reset_threshold' is optional; default = trigger_threshold - 5.0. (A010, A015, A023.) (v0.1.5, Q-S121: schema range constraints removed — A010 / A015 / A023 / A034 enforce the spec-level numeric bounds with human-readable Errors.)

trigger_threshold.description: (v0.1.5, Q-S121) Need value at or above which the trigger fires. Spec range (0.0, 100.0] (A010, tightened in Q-S15 to strictly positive) is enforced by the C# Validator, not by schema minimum/maximum. See `need_value` description for rationale.

reset_threshold.description: (v0.1.5, Q-S108 + Q-S121) Need value at or below which the trigger re-arms. Optional; default trigger_threshold - 5.0 (Composer fills via Q-S11). Must be strictly less than trigger_threshold (A023). Range enforcement via A034 (explicit-negative Error) and A023 (post-fill trigger > reset). Q-S108 first removed schema minimum; Q-S121 generalizes the principle to all range constraints in this schema.

trigger.description: Germio Bus event template. Allowed placeholder: {agent_id} (A015). Plain strings without placeholders are also allowed.

binding.description: Germio integration binding. May be omitted (A016 raises Warning when omitted).

on_action_change.description: Germio Bus event template fired when the chosen behavior changes. Allowed placeholders: {agent_id}, {behavior} (A015 + Q-S46).

kind.description: Kind = a reusable Persona slice. Kinds are referenced by Persona.kind_ids and merged via Composer (A011a, A019, A032).

persona.description: Persona = the per-agent definition. May reference Kinds via kind_ids; merged values follow §17 cascade rules.
